title: Exercise: Haal YR3PT25-26 (18/12/25)
description:
Assalaamualaykum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakaatuhu.

Please complete this exercise before your next lesson.

There are 74 questions in total. Each question is valued at 1 point.
A score below 70 is a fail.
A score of 70 and above is a pass.

In order to complete this exercise, you must use your notes. 
Look at them, read them, understand them, use them.

If you need any assistance, you can email me at: [email removed]
or 
You can send me a message on Google Classroom.

items.title: Complete the following statements
items.description:
Complete the following statements by choosing ALL that is applicable from the options below.

Tip: Read the statements slowly and clearly whilst understanding the scenario. Then search for the rule in your notes, confirm it and then respond.

options: ...a مركب غير مفيد like: طالعَ جبلٍ

checked.label: ...a مركب غير مفيد like: طالعَ جبلٍ

correctBlock: ...a مركب غير مفيد like: طالعَ جبلٍ

options: ...the condition of the subject or object when the action is conducted.
...the method an action is conducted in.
...the place an action is conducted in.
...the reason for an action being conducted.

checked.label: ...the condition of the subject or object when the action is conducted.

items.title: 4. According to the Jamhoor, the  حال will generally...

...be in relation to the مفعول به.

...be in relation to the مضاف إليه.

items.title: 19. When the حال is a فعل ماضي, generally, it has قد preceding it (provided there isn't a reason to prevent قد). The purpose of this قد is to...

options: ...provide a meaning of close past tense (القريب) in order to bring it close to the مضارع verb because the مضارع verb is the closest to an اسم الفاعل which is what حال should be in principle.
...provide a meaning of ceirtainty (التحقيق) in order to ascertain the حال so it is absolutely clear and ratified.
...provide a meaning of emphasis (التأكيد) in order to remove doubt since the حال is in the past and it could become doubtful.

checked.label: ...provide a meaning of close past tense (القريب) in order to bring it close to the مضارع verb because the مضارع verb is the closest to an اسم الفاعل which is what حال should be in principle.

items.title: 20. A فعل ماضي حال is prevented from being preceded by قد...

options: ...when the فعل ماضي comes after إلّا.
...when the فعل ماضي is free from a رابط.
...when the فعل ماضي is free from a واو حالية.
...when the فعل ماضي is connected with أو.

...when the فعل ماضي is connected with أو.
...when the فعل ماضي comes after إلّا.

correctBlock: ...when the فعل ماضي is connected with أو.
...when the فعل ماضي comes after إلّا.

options: ...can never be preceded by قد, whether the واو حالية is there or not..
...can be preceded by قد only if the واو حالية is absent.
...can be preceded by قد and the واو حالية will also be necessary.

checked.label: ...can be preceded by قد and the واو حالية will also be necessary.

options: ...a حال which is in no tense (tenseless, timeless in another dimension) that's why it's called مقدّرة because it's to do with decree (تقدير).
...a حال which is in the past tense.

items.description:
Important instructions
Look at the following sentences. A loose translation has been provided and focus on حال ذوالحال has been ignored on purpose, however, potential حال ذوالحال has been underlined in the sentences.
Considering the rules of واو حالية, workout which construction is a حال and which isn't.
Workout whether the واو حالية is necessary, permissible or prevented then tick the corresponding box.
Explain your answer by breifly detailing your choice. Mention why it can't be a حال if you think it isn't a حال. This could be because a واو حالية is missing where it was necessary or vice versa, amongst other factors. Or mention why it is حال if you think it is حال considering a similar thought process. You will lose a mark if your explanation is not in line with your answer OR if you don't explain your answer properly.
                           Use your notes. Look at them, read them, understand them.

dom.feedback: The action of "seeing" was done upon them whilst they were "walking away". "They" performed the action of "walking away" whilst being "arrogant". "Walking away", which is فعل مضارع مثبت without a قد, is a haal but will not have a waaw haaliyyah. "Being arrogant" is also haal. And it requires a waaw haaliyah as it is a jumla ismiyyah beginning with a dhameer raabit.

items.title: Correct or Incorrect (not just حال)
items.description:
Important instructions
The construction of the following sentences may be incorrect.
Errors are not limited to حال ذوالحال errors, there may be a few outside of the topic of حال ذوالحال. Get your bigger Nahw cap on.
Choose correct or incorrect from the options by ticking the corresponding boxes. A very literal translation has been provided to assist you in your quest. So, in order to make your choice, you MUST align the sentence with the translation and only then make your choice.
Provide the number of errors you think are present by ticking the boxes labeled with numbers.
Finally, explain your answer by detailing each of the errors and the method of rectifying those errors in order to salvage the sentence. You will lose a mark if your explanation is not in line with your answer OR if you don't explain your answer properly.
                           Use your notes. Look at them, read them, understand them.

items.title: 1c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: 'Ilm' should have kasrah as it is mudaf ilayh. Mamloo'oon should be mansoob (mamloo'een) as it is haal.

items.title: 2c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

items.title: 3c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: There should be a Waaw Haaliyyah before Qad because it is a فعل مضارع مثبت with قد and the dhameer raabit is present.

items.title: 4c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: The Zul Haal is the pronoun in the verb `راجع` which is in reference to Amir, who is a male, so the haal should correlate in number and gender. Therefore, it should be thaabitan (not thaabitatan)

items.title: 5c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: 1st, والداك should be والديك in the state of نصب because it's مفعول به of إحترم. 2nd, the waw haaliyah is not permissible because the construction of the haal is Fil Maadhi connected to 'Au' Harful ataf. 3rd, the verb غاب should be in the dual form غابا, because the Fa'il should be dual and in reference to 'والداك' both parents and therefore should correlate in number and gender.

items.title: 6c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: Thaabitatan ثابتة should be thaabitan ثابتا, as it is the haal and it should correlate in N&G to the zul haal (pronoun هو inside يثبت).

items.title: 7c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: The word ثلاثة should have a fathah as it is zarf (time/place). The مضاف إليه of إكرام should be plural, هم, as it is referring to the guests who are plural.

items.title: 8c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: The word دارس should be دارسا, it should be mansoob because it is the haal of Zaid.

items.title: 9c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: There should be a waaw haaliyyah before 'هو' because the haal 'هو شبعان' is a jumlah ismiyyah which begins with the dhameer raabit. Also, شبعانِ should be شبعانُ as it is مرفوع because of being the خبر of هو and it's also غير منصرف hence no tanween. Also, it should be 'بطنه' because it is referring to the stomach of zaid and he is male (hopefully).

items.title: 10c. Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them.
items.description: If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".

dom.feedback: No mistakes. As for مرتج, it's an اسم المنقوص like قاضٍ and it's in the state of رفع
